scope: Static original equipment metadata only; not view or motion qualification

inspection.method: One game-size static contact sheet of ten existing masters; selective original cavalry/THD and selected256 TNT inspection. No continuous motion or browser observation.
inspection.scale: round(identity.layoutLock.render.width * 1.68), whole square canvas. THD/TNT missing layoutLock use matching manifest asset render.width42. No fitting or cropping.

limits: Existence and byte hashes do not establish understanding, permission, approval or tool availability.
Explicit invocation only; this helper is not a mandatory global hook.
Externally verify tools and actual live handles/preservation guards; no guards are declared closed.

equipment.basis: A barrel rests on a wheeled wooden carriage; no human crew is visible.

gripOrAssemblyTrace.rule: Preserve only observed original contact/assembly; unseen anatomy and occluded connections remain unasserted.
